compiled_state.title: S7-T1: CONFLICT_DATA schema parity regression test
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: merge-to-main-direct.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh both emit CONFLICT_DATA output with the same schema on merge conflict
- DD2: A regression test verifies CONFLICT_DATA schema compatibility between both modes

## Description
Write a new regression test `tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh` that drives both `merge-to-main-direct.sh` and `merge-to-main-pr.sh` through their conflict paths and asserts the emitted `CONFLICT_DATA` JSON has identical key sets and value shape.

## Files to Modify
- `tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh` (CREATE)

## TDD Test Cases
1. `test_direct_mode_emits_canonical_conflict_data_schema` — drive direct mode into a conflict (set up conflicting branch fixture); capture stdout; assert single `CONFLICT_DATA` line; parse JSON; assert keys are exactly `{branch, base_branch, conflicted_files, resolution_strategy}`; assert `conflicted_files` is a JSON array
2. `test_pr_mode_emits_canonical_conflict_data_schema` — drive PR mode into the CONFLICTING gh-pr-view path (with stub `gh` returning `mergeable=CONFLICTING`); capture stdout; same key/shape assertions
3. `test_both_modes_emit_identical_key_sets` — run both modes against equivalent fixtures; assert `set(direct_keys) == set(pr_keys)` and field types match

Stubbing: `gh` shadowed via PATH; both scripts source `merge-helpers.sh` so the test exercises the real `_emit_conflict_data` function.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test runs and exits 0
  Verify: bash tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh
- [ ] Test file is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh
- [ ] All 3 test functions present
  Verify: grep -c '^test_' tests/integration/test-conflict-data-schema-parity.sh | awk '$1>=3'
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with markers for both source files
  Verify: grep -E 'merge-to-main-(direct|pr)\.sh' .test-index | grep -q test-conflict-data-schema-parity
- [ ] Tests assert behavior (parse JSON, compare key sets) — no source-file greps as primary assertion

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet to opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
